title: Accessing Längle's 4FMs Through Guided Meditation — 3FM: May I be myself? (The Person)
description: A guided meditation on the third of Alfried Längle's Four Fundamental Motivations (4FMs) — The Person: May I be myself? — translating its three existential prerequisites (Attention, Justice, and Appreciation) into guided imagery. Includes the audio recording, full transcript (PDF/TXT), captions (VTT) and word-level timings (CSV). Companion to the WCET4 (2026) workshop by Graham Nelson-Zutter.
